About Maya

I'm a digital and traditional illustrator based in Portland, Oregon, with over eight years of professional experience creating visual art for publishing, branding, and entertainment. My work blends watercolor techniques with digital painting, resulting in warm, narrative-driven illustrations.

I specialize in character design, children's book illustration, and editorial artwork. My clients range from independent authors and small businesses to major publishing houses and tech startups. Every project is an opportunity to tell a story and create something meaningful.

When I'm not illustrating, you'll find me at local coffee shops sketching, exploring Portland's parks for inspiration, or teaching illustration workshops at the community art center.

Commission Info

How the Commission Process Works

1

Inquiry & Consultation

Reach out with your commission idea using the form below or via email. We'll discuss your vision, style preferences, and any specific details you'd like included in your illustration.

2

Quote & Agreement

I'll provide a custom quote based on complexity, size, and timeline. Once you agree to the terms, a 50% deposit secures your spot on my schedule.

3

Concept Sketch

You'll receive an initial sketch for approval. This is your chance to request changes to composition, pose, or details before I move to the final illustration.

4

Final Artwork

I'll create the finished illustration based on your approved sketch. You'll see progress updates along the way and can request minor revisions.

5

Delivery

Once you're happy with the final piece and the remaining 50% is paid, you'll receive high-resolution digital files (and physical prints if included in your package).

Pricing Tiers

All prices include digital delivery at 300 DPI. Physical prints available upon request for an additional fee.

Character Portrait

$300 – $500

  • Single character, bust to full-body
  • Simple background or transparent
  • 1 concept sketch revision round
  • Turnaround: 2–3 weeks
Popular

Scene Illustration

$600 – $900

  • Multiple characters or detailed scene
  • Detailed background
  • 2 concept sketch revision rounds
  • Turnaround: 3–4 weeks

Book Cover or Campaign

$1000+

  • Custom design for your specific project
  • Multiple layout options or variations
  • Unlimited concept revisions
  • Turnaround: 4–6 weeks (negotiable)

Rush fees and commercial use licenses available. Contact me to discuss your specific needs.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer rush commissions?

Yes, I do offer expedited turnarounds for an additional rush fee (typically 25–50% of the base price, depending on timeline). Please mention this when you inquire, and I'll let you know availability.

What file formats and resolutions do you provide?

All final commissions are delivered as high-resolution PNG and JPG files (300 DPI) suitable for printing. I can also provide PSD files if you need editable layers, for an additional fee.

Can I use my commission commercially or for print?

Standard commissions are for personal use only. Commercial licensing (for merchandise, publication, or resale) requires a separate agreement and additional fee. I'm happy to discuss this—just ask!

What's your payment and refund policy?

I require a 50% deposit to begin work, with the balance due upon completion. Refunds are available only if I'm unable to complete the commission. Once work has begun, deposits are non-refundable but can be transferred to a future project.

Do you offer discounts for multiple commissions?

Absolutely! I offer 10% off the total for 2–3 commissions and 15% off for 4 or more. Bulk project inquiries are encouraged—let's work out a custom package.

How far in advance should I book?

Current availability varies, but I typically have a 2–4 week lead time. For custom projects or peak seasons (holidays, awards season), booking further ahead is recommended. Contact me to check availability for your desired timeline.

What if I don't like the final result?

I include revision rounds with each tier. If there's a significant issue, I'll work with you until you're satisfied. My goal is to deliver art you love.

Ready to Collaborate?

Fill out the form below to start your commission inquiry. I'll respond within 2 business days with next steps and a custom quote.
